description: Zoom Guitar Lab: patch editor and librarian for Zoom guitar multi-effects pedals. Manages effects, amp models and artist patches, and backs up patches.
notes: Runs Zoom's InstallShield setup, which installs to Program Files, outside the Scoop directory.
Uninstall via Windows 'Apps & features', not 'scoop uninstall'.
Connect the pedal by USB and set it to the correct USB mode before launching.
